name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix; chapter_ch20 is a valid chapter domain ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful, not address residue); descriptor end_scene2_char_pos_x_table reflects role (chapter-20 end handler, scene-2 character X-position) and data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue (address 0x52216 does not appear as a suffix). Consistent with sibling tables (scene1_char_pos_x_table, scene2_char_pos_y_table) and ch21..ch30 analogues.
purpose: Read-only table of X world-tile coordinates for the 9 scene-2 cast members (runtime_char slots 0x34..0x3C) placed during chapter 20's end-scene transition.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_chapter_20_end copies all 9 bytes onto stack scratch in its prologue, then in a loop i=0..8 assigns runtime_char[i+0x34].pos_x = table[i] (the companion *_scene2_char_pos_y_table @ 0x5221F supplies pos_y; sprite_state[1] is set to 3 for each). Pure data; no computation.
element_semantics: Each byte is the X world-tile coordinate (0x1C..0x1E observed) for one scene-2 character; element i targets runtime_char slot (0x34 + i). Values: {0x1E,0x1C,0x1C,0x1C,0x1C,0x1C,0x1D,0x1D,0x1D}.
